verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents its own programmatic APIs and API keys. These cover alert ingestion, case creation and update, batch case import, case listing and retrieval, and filing validation and status monitoring, so core workflows can run without the UI. Nothing in the evidence shows a CLI, CI/CD integration, or a published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), so 'headless / in CI' is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: CLI or headless runner, CI pipeline integration docs, OpenAPI/API reference, auth/rate-limit details for automation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
